tei:div.tei:p: (1na)tshogs chos bkra shis phun tshogs bzhugs so//

"$ (1ba)༄༅// na mo ratna gu ru/ bkra shis phun tshogs dpal dang ldan// bde skyid dge legs thams cad kyi// 'byung gnas bla ma rin po che// 'gro mgon rje la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro mgon rin po che sgam po pa'i zhal nas/ las dang po pa'i gang zag gcig sangs rgyas kyi sar 'gro ba la lam gnyis las med/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam dang*/ gsang sngags kyi lam dang gnyis yin gsung*/ de la dang po ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam lha byang chub 'od kyis jo bo rje spyan drangs nas/ jo bos byang chub lam gyi sgron me gsungs/ de la sku mched gsum gyis skyes bu gsum bya bar bkral/ de ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam yin te/ gang zag gi dbang po rab 'bring gsum la chos drug cig dgos/ drug gang zhe na 'jug pa'i cho ga /bsrung bya/ bsgom bya/ mnyan bya/ las/ 'bras bu dang drug go /dang po 'jug pa'i cho ga ni/ skyes bu chung ngu'i dus su ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal la 'jigs nas bla ma gcig la chos shig (2na)zhus pas/ bla ma des dang po skyabs su 'gro ba la slob pa ni/ skyabs 'gro 'bogs pa'i tshig ste 'jug pa'i cho ga'o// gnyis pa bsrung bya ni bslab bya rnams dang*/ gsum pa bsgom bya ni/ ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal/ bzhi pa nyan bya ni/ las 'bras kyi chos/ lnga pa las ni/ bsod nams kyi tshogs/ drug pa 'bras bu ni/ lha mi'o// de nas dge bsnyen gyi dus su dang po skyabs 'gro byas nas/ rtsa ba bzhi chang dang lnga'i sdom pa 'bogs pa ni 'jug pa'i cho ga /mi dge ba bcu chang dang bcu gcig spangs nas/ bslab bya'i steng du dge ba bcu dang du len pa bsrung bya/ bsgom bya man chad gong mas 'gre/ de nas skyes bu 'bring gi dus su dge tshul gyi sdom pa ni dang po skyabs 'gro byed/ de nas mkhan pos bzhi/ slob dpon gyis bcu 'bogs pa ni 'jug pa'i cho ga'o// bsrung bya ni bslab bya'i steng du 'od ldan dang kā ri kā dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs nyan/

las dang 'bras bu (2ba)ni gong dang mthun/ dge slong la khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum gyi sdom pa 'bogs/ bsrung bya ni bka' so sor thar pa'am 'dul ba nas ji ltar byung ba bzhin bsrung*/ gzhan dge tshul dang mthun no// skyes bu mchog gi dus su dang po skyabs 'gro khyad par can byed/ de nas 'jug pa'i sems bskyed de gsum sdom pa'i cho ga /skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya'i steng du byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya la sogs pa sdom pa nyi shu pa nas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin bsrung ba ni bsrung bya/ bsgom bya byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems 'ba' zhig tu bsgom/ mnyan bya ni sems can thams cad la phan 'dogs pa'i chos 'ba' zhig mnyan/ las ni bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs ched du gsog /'bras bu ni sems bskyed nas stong pa nyid bstan pas srid du rung bas stong pa nyid rtogs nas sangs rgya'o// de thams cad kyi sngon du skyabs 'gro 'ong ba ci ste zhe na/ skyabs 'gro ni sdom pa'i ngo bo yin te/ rgyud sdom pa gsum ldan nas/ sdom pa kun la yod mod kyi// skyabs su ma song ba la med// ces gsungs pas skyabs 'gro ma btang na/ rtsa ba bzhi shor bslab bya nyams pa las/ sdom pa shor kyang sdom pa'i ro yin te/ dper na sbrang ma sna bar gtser ba dang 'dra/ phyir skyor na skyabs 'gro skyor dgos/ rtsa ba bzhi blang bya yin pas blangs pas chog /skyabs 'gro shor na sdom pa yang dung gi rdul phyis pa bzhin 'gro /skyabs 'gro nyams pa'i rgyu dang 'chor ba'i rgyu gnyis yin/ nyams pa ni/ sha gcod pa dang*/ sna 'bugs pa dang*/ spu 'bal ba dang*/ sgra gcan go rar 'jug pa dang lnga'o// 'chor ba'i rgyu ni dkon mchog gsum gyi skyabs de mi 'dod do byas nas btang na (3na)'chor/ ma btang na mi 'chor gsung*/ yang chos rje sgam po pa'i zhal nas/ tshe la long med pas chos mang po byed mi khom/

sgrub pa'i dus la bab/ sgrub pa la chos mang po mi dgos/ tshe 'di la blo log na chos tshig bzhi pa'i tshigs su bcad pa re re la brten nas bsgrubs pas chog gsung*/ de yang chos thams cad kyi gzhi'am rtsa ba ni dad pa yin te/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la dad/ des gsungs pa'i chos la dad/ de sgrub pa'i dge 'dun la dad/ de ltar dad tsa na dus rtag tu dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song ba yin/ de yang yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhig dang ma phrad na dad pa de yang ji ltar 'gro cha med de/ de bas dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams pa gal che/ de yang dper na mi gces pa cig na nas sman pa cig 'tshol na shin tu mkhas pa cig 'tshol dgos/ mkhas pa des nad kyi gzhi shes rgyu shes/ bcos pa'i thabs shes/ gzhi rlung mkhris bad kan gsum/ rgyu nyon mongs pa gsum/ 'dod chags las rlung*/ gti mug las bad kan/ zhe sdang las mkhris pa/ de bcos pa'i thabs ni sman gyi ro tsha ba/ kha ba mngar ba gsum la sogs pa/ bshal ba dang*/ skyug pa dang me btsa' dang*/ thur ma dang*/ gtar ka la sogs pa byed/ de ltar byas pas nad pa de sos nas 'ong*/ sman pa mi mkhas pa cig gis 'chos na dang po nad kyi gzhi ma shes/ nad ngos ma zin pas bcos log byas pas nad pa 'chi/ ma shi yang shi la thug pa zhig 'ong*/ de bas na 'chi ba mi rtag pa nas mgo bzung nas/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid rnal mar ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhig (3ba)gal che/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid ni/ rang yang 'chi ba dang mi rtag pa bsgoms la/ gzhan yang de bsgom du 'jug na dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin/ rang yang byams pa dang snying rje bsgoms/ gzhan yang de bsgom du 'jug na dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin/ rang yang chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs stong pa nyid bsgoms/ gzhan yang de bsgom du 'jug na dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin/ yang na dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid ni gnyis te/

shes rab kyi mig can dang*/ chos kyi mig can gnyis so// shes rab kyi mig can ni 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid dang*/ las rgyu 'bras dang*/ rten 'brel tshogs pa las byung ba dang*/ rgyu dang 'bras bu ji ltar byung ba la sogs pa shes pa ni/ shes rab kyi mig can no// chos kyi mig can ni/ rgyud la ye shes shar ba'i rang gi khyab 'brel gzhan la bskrun nus pa'o// yang dag pa'i bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid ni bzhi ldan zhes bya ste/ zab mo'i chos la nges pa'i bdag thob pa/ sems can la snying rje'i bdag thob pa/ dkon mchog gsum la dad pa'i bdag thob pa/ 'gro ba rnams la zang zing med pa'i chos ston pa/ de lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsten dgos/ log pa'i bshes gnyen dang phrad na/ be'u sprel g.yang la bskyur ba dang 'dra ste/ thams cad thur la 'gro /chos bya rgyu ni bsag sbyang gnyis las med/ sdig pa sbyangs pas bsod nams bsags/ bsod nams bsags pas sdig pa sbyongs/ rang gi sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa 'di rgyu las byung ste/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pas bsod nams bsags pas rgyu 'dis byas par mthong bas na rgyu las byung ba'i tshul du 'dug /'di rkyen las (4na)byung ste/ byams snying rje byang chub sems bsgoms pas bsod nams bsags rkyen 'dis byas par mthong bas na/ rkyen las byung ba'i tshul du yang 'dug /'di thabs las byung ste/ byams snying rje bsgoms kyin sems bsgoms pa las bsod nams bsags pas thabs 'dis byas par mthong bas na/ thabs las byung ba'i tshul du yang 'dug /de bas na bsod nams bsags pa gal che'o gsung ngo*/// /yang chos rje sgam po pa'i zhal nas/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgoms pas tshe 'di'i don mi byed/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgoms pas 'khor bar mi skye/ las rgyu 'bras bsgoms pas ngan song du mi skye/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pas nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas su mi lhung*/

chos zab mo stong nyid bsgoms pas gzugs dang gzugs med kyi khams su mi skye gsung*/ de yang 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgoms pa la phan yon lnga yod de/ skyo ba skye ba yin/ dad pa gso ba yin/ brtson 'grus can du 'gyur ba yin/ 'jig rten la mi chags pa yin/ mya ngan las 'das pa la phyogs pa yin/ 'chi ba sgom pa la rab 'bring tha gsum yin/ rab kyis dngos po zhag tu mi 'dzin/ 'bring gis zla bar mi 'dzin/ tha mas kyang lor mi 'dzin pa zhig 'ong ba yin gsung*/// /yang rje sgam po rin po che'i zhal nas/ zhi gnas skye bar byed pa la/ rgyu bzhi yin te/ bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis skye bar byed pa dang*/ rten 'brel gyis skye ba dang*/ tshogs bsags pa las skye ba dang*/ sdig pa sbyangs pa las skye ba dang bzhi yin gsung*/ de yang sems kyi ngo bo ma bcos ma bslad pa/ rnal ma/ gsal ba/ dag pa dus thams cad du rgyun chad med (4ba)pa yin/ de la gnyis te/ snang ba la nges pa dang*/ snang la ma nges pa'o// ston kha'i nam mkha' lta bu dang sems nyid gnyis su med par rtogs pas te/ yar sangs rgyas la mi re/ mar 'khor ba la mi dogs/ gzhan gyis bsgyur yang mi 'gyur ba ste/ snang la nges pa yin/ ma nges pa ni nyams myong la'ang bzhi ste/ zhi gnas kyi bde ba dang gsal ba mi rtog pa'o// nyams la res yod/ res med pa snyam byed pa ste/ mi rtog pas rgyu byas nas/ mar la ldog pa'i nyen yod/ gzugs khams dang gzugs med pa la 'gog pa'i rgyur yang 'gro nyen yod/ dang po slob pa'i dus su rig pa gsal sing nge ba la slobs/ de yang shes pa ma yengs pa la slobs/ de yang rig pa'i ngo bo la ye ma yengs par bya/ de la goms tsa na rang la nges shes skye ba yin/ sems kyi ngo bo ma shor bar byas nas/ rnam rtog ji tsam yang 'phro ba yin/ dper na nam mkha' rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa yin yang*/ sprin dang na bun dang khug sna la sogs pa ji tsam yang 'ong ba yin/

de nam mkha' rang la dengs nas 'gro ba dang 'dra ste/ de yang rnam rtog grogs su 'gro ba bya ba yin/ rnam rtog la spro bsdu ma btub na slar thu ba yin/ gzugs med du skye ba'i nyen yod/ yi dam lha'i bskyed rim rdzogs pa yang skad cig ma re bsgom/ skad cig dran rdzogs kyis yi dam lhar bskyed nas/ 'od gsal 'ba' zhig bsgoms pa yin/ de yang gsal sing nge ba de nyams myong yin/ de la ma yengs pa gnas pa yin/ shes rab kyis bltas pas ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pa rtogs pa yin/ bla ma rtogs ldan zhig gis slob ma skal ldan tshe 'di blos btang ba zhig dang phrad nas/ bla ma des ma smin pa smin par byed pa'i dbang rnam pa bzhi (5na)mdzad nas/ smin te grol bar byed pa'i thabs bskyed rdzogs gnyis la slob pa yin/ bskyed rim lha'i sku sgyu ma lta bu bsgom pa dang*/ rtsa rlung bsgom pa dang*/ spros pa dang bcas pa'i rdzogs rim kyang de yin/ spros med kyi rdzogs rim ni 'od gsal sems kyi stong nyid mngon sum du gzigs pa 'di lags/ de ltar bskyed rdzogs gnyis bsgoms pas yon tan 'byung ste/ de yang dben par bsgoms pa las 'byung*/ lus bde na sems bde bar 'ong ste/ nang du rtags rnam pa lnga 'char/ spyir yang phan yon rnam pa brgyad 'byung ste/ rtags dang phan yon du ba lta bu byung tsa na/ rlung 'gags te rlung a ba dhū tir tshud pa yin/ rtags gnyis pa shar tsa na/ snang ba nyams su myong ba 'ong ste/ phyi'i snang ba 'di la mi zer/ sems kyis sems nyid nyams su myong ba bya ba yin/ rtags gsum pa shar tsa na gsal ba mi rtog pa 'byung*/ de bsgom pa'i mthar thug pa yin/ rlung sems gnas su tshud pa yin/ rtags bzhi pa shar tsa na/ lta ba'i don chos nyid thams cad rig cing gsal ba dang phrin las rnam pa bzhi 'grub ste/ lta ba'i don bya ba yin/ sems nyid la blo nges pa'o// chos thams cad rig cing gsal ba ni 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad 'od gsal du 'char ba'o// phrin las bzhi ni bzlas pa la sogs pa bya mi dgos pa'i phrin las bzhi ka byas kyang tshegs chung ngus 'grub pa'o// rlung 'od gsal du tshud pa'i dus su ye shes kyi rtags 'byung ste/

lus 'ja' tshon nam 'od kyi gong bu lta bu yang 'byung ngo*// de ye shes kyi rtags byung ba yin/ lta ba dang lta byed med pa la stong nyid zer ba yin/ khams gsum las 'das shing blo dang bral ba la smon pa med pa zer (5ba)ba yin gsung*/ yang chos rje sgam po pa'i zhal nas/ sgrub pa po la bdud kyi bar chad 'byung ba ni gnyis te/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i bdud dang*/ rnam par rtog pa'i bdud do// de sel ba'i thabs gsum yod de/ dang po byams pa dang snying rjes sel ba yin te/ byams snying rje bsgoms pa las mas bu la gnod pa mi srid pa yin/ gnyis pa ni sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu dang stong pa nyid bsgoms pas sel te/ gnod bya gnod byed gnyis med/ gsum pa 'khrul par shes pas sel te/ de thams cad sems kyi rnam 'phrul du shes te/ gnod pa byed kyang mi tshugs/ de la 'khor mang po dang rdzas kyi bsod nams chen po 'byung ba ni/ gsang sngags nas thun mong gi dngos grub tu bshad/ bdud kyi bar chad kyang yin gsung*/ bdud kyis kyang dngos su bar du mi chod de/ sngon la 'khor gyis bar du gcod/ de nas rdzas dang bsod nams che bas dge sbyor gyi bar du gcod/ de nas sgrub pa po de la chags sdang gis bar du bcad nas 'gro ba yin/ bdud kyi bar chad yin nam min/ rang gi sems la blta/ rang la gnod na bdud kyi bar chad yin/ mi gnod na dngos grub yin gsung*/// /yang chos rje sgam po pa'i zhal nas/ ston pa bde bar gshegs pas gsungs pa'i chos thams cad bslab pa rnam pa gsum du ma 'dus pa med gsung*/ de yang bslab pa rnam pa gsum ni/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa dang*/ lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa gsum yin/ de la tshul khrims kyi bslab pa gang yin na/ mkhan po dang slob dpon la so so thar pa'i sdom pa blangs nas ji lta ba bzhin bsrung ba ni sdom pa'i tshul khrims/

de nas smon pa dang 'jug pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/ byang chub sems (6na)dpa'i bslab bya la slob pa ni sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ de nas gsang sngags kyi dbang zhus nas rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi/ yan lag gi brgyad la sogs pa'i dam tshig ji lta ba bzhin bsrung ba ni sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ gang zag gcig gi rgyud la/ sdom pa gsum rten 'brel skor cig tu gnas dgos te/ skye na ji ltar skye/ gnas na ji ltar gnas/ bsrung na ji ltar bsrung*/ ldan na ji ltar ldan/ 'chos na ji ltar 'chos snyam na/ mkhan slob la sdom pa blangs pa'i dus su ngas so sor thar pa'i sdom pa thob snyam pa'i dus su skye/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa thob snyam pa'i dus su byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa skye/ dbang bskur ba'i dus su gsang sngags kyi dam tshig thob snyam pa'i dus su/ gsang sngags kyi sdom pa skye/ gnas na bye brag tu gnas te/ bye brag gang zhe na/ de ltar mnyam pa'i ngo bo cig so sor yod pa ma yin te/ sems nyid kyi ngo bo gang zag gcig gi rgyud la gsum tshang ba'o// bsrung na 'chol bar bsrung ste/ 'chol ba gang zhe na/ so thar gyi dus su 'dul ba 'od ldan bzhin du bsrung*/ sems bskyed byas nas sdom pa nyi shu pa la sogs pa bzhin bsrung*/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bya/ dbang bskur nas rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi pa la sogs pa nas/ ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du gsang sngags kyi dam tshig bsrung*/ ldan na yar ldan te nang thug byung ba'i dus su/ 'og ma gong ma'i khongs na yod pas rim gyis gong ma gtso cher bya/ 'chos nas so sor thar pa la skyon byung na/ mkhan po la sogs pa la bshags pas chog na bshags/ skyor dgos byung na skyor/ byang chub sems dpa'i dus su skyon byung na/ sems bskyed pa'i byang chub (6ba)sems dpa' la bshags pas chog na bshags/ skyor dgos na skyor/ de ni lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'o// lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa ni/

sdom pa rnams la bdag gis so sor thar pa'i dus su skyon ma byung ngam/ byang chub sems dpa'i dus su skyon ma byung ngam/ gsang sngags kyi dus su skyon ma byung ngam snyam du sngo bgrang byed cing*/ rang sems glang po che smyon pa dang 'dra ba de/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi dmigs pa'i ka ba la dran pa'i zhags thag gis bcings/ shes rab kyi lcags kyus bzung nas/ blo rim gyis goms par byed pa ni zhi gnas so// de ltar zhi gnas kyis sems rtse gcig tu byas nas lhag mthong gis dpyod gzhig 'byed do// sdom pa la rtog dpyod btang bas ji srid rtog dpyod 'dug phan chad du bsags pa'i shes rab yin la/ rtog dpyod las 'das phan chad bsgoms pa'i shes rab bo// lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa ni/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin spros pa dang bral ba de go zhing*/ rtogs na shes rab kyi bslab pa yin gsung*/// /yang chos rje sgam po pa'i zhal nas/ tshe la long med myur du 'chi bas 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad la ma chags pa zhig dgos gsung*/ de yang rigs drug gar skyes kyang skyid med cing*/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi phung por shes pas 'khor ba mtha' dag la ma chags pa zhig dgos/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba snying rje yin pas/ dus thams cad du sems can blos mi spong ba zhig dgos/ chos thams cad ma skyes shing skye ba med par shes pas/ gang la yang dngos po dang mtshan mar mi 'dzin pa zhig dgos/ chos de rnams rgyud la skye bar byed pa la bla ma dang jo bo dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la dad pa dang gus pa rgyun (7na)mi 'chad pa'i sgo nas mchod pa dang gsol ba 'debs pa rgyun mi 'chad pa zhig dgos/ yun ring du goms pa'i ma rig pa'i bag chags mthug pos 'khrul pa'i shes pa sna tshogs su shar yang byis pa chung ngu'i dpe dang*/ seṅge'i grib ma'i dpe dang*/ rab rib can gyi skra shad kyi sgo nas 'khrul pa bcas/

snang ba dang sems tha mi dad pa ni chu dang chab rom gyi dpe dang*/ tsandan dang dri'i sgo nas rtogs par bya'o// snang ba la chos sku'i khyab pa'i dpe ni/ gser rdo dang dngul rdo dang 'o ma la mar gyis khyab pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas rtogs par bya'o// med bzhin du snang ba ni du ba dang sprin dang khug sna dang gzugs brnyan dang brag cha la sogs pa'i dpe'i sgo nas rtogs par bya'o// rten 'brel tshogs pa las snang ba ni me long gi gzugs brnyan dang*/ chu zla dang*/ nor bu rin po che'i dpe la sogs pa'i sgo nas rtogs par bya'o// de ltar chos thams cad gdod ma nas yod ma myong ba 'khrul pa'i ngo bor snang ba ste/ rmi lam lta bur rang gi sems kyi gzugs brnyan don ma yin pa don ltar shar bar go bar bya/ de bas chos thams cad brdzun pas bslu ba ming tsam mam/ btags pa tsam don de lta bu'i kun rdzob de yang sgyu ma ltar yod med kyi mtha' gnyis dang bral bar rtogs par bya/ de ltar don spyi'i rnam pa yul du byas nas rtogs pa thob snyam yang don mi mthong gsung ste/ de bas na/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa cig gis dbang byin rlabs kyi sgo nas rgyud smin par byas nas bla mas thabs nyams su len du bcug pa las 'ong ste/ de yang gsang sngags kyi man ngag rten 'brel tshogs pa las skye bas bde ba gsal ba mi rtog pa gsum gyi nyams 'byung*/ de yang dad pa dang gus pa'i sgo nas yun ring du nyams su blangs (7ba)pa las 'byung ste/ rlung sems 'byongs pa'i rtags lus ras bal gyi 'dab ma lta bu la sogs pa'i nyams mang du 'ong*/ srog rtsol dhū tir tshud pa'i stobs kyis rtags lnga dang phan yon brgyad la sogs pa'i rtags mang du 'byung*/ de lta bu'i lus sems bde ba ci byung yang zhi gnas yin/ 'on kyang rtags lnga dang phan yon brgyad po zhi gnas dang lhag mthong zung du 'brel ba las 'byung ste/

dmigs pa phra mo zin pa'i gnas pa lteng lteng las mi 'byung ngo*// de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi yin/ de yang lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i don gsum gyis bsam gtan gyi dga' bde bsgom pa yin gsung*/ bla ma chos kyi spyan can sems nyid stong pa nyid mngon sum du byas pa zhig gis bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum skye med du nges su 'jug /skye med du ma nges na ni snang la ma nges pa zhes bya ste/ so sor brtags min gyi 'gog par 'gro /thun mong gi lam yin pas gar skye cha med pa yin/ nges pa'i shes pa skyes nas rtog pa dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid yul mngon sum nyid kyi bar du shes gsung ngo*// bde gsal mi rtog pa med par sems skye med kyi ngo bo tsam la yang nges na// bla ma mi la'i zhal nas/ de de yin te de de min// sdong po yin te 'bras bu min// yon tan yin te rtog med min// gsung*/ jo bo chen po'i zhal nas/ nges 'byung bag chags bral bas rnal 'byor ma mthong ba/ nam mkha'i me tog bung bas 'jib pa 'dra gsung*/ de bas na/ chos thams cad sems kyi rang bzhin yin pas sems kyi chos nyid rtogs pas chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid rtogs pa yin no// de bas na/ sems kyi rang bzhin gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba/ chos sku'i ngo bo rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byung yang rung (8na)ma byung yang rung ste gnas pas na rten ces bya'o// de la/ rnam par rtog pa rnam spangs pa// gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba// ye shes 'dus ma byas pa ste// rgyu dang rkyen gyis ma bskyed pa// zhes gsungs so// de lta bu'i sems kyi chos nyid rtogs pa ni zag pa med pa'i sdom pa/ sa dang po pa'i mngon sum yin te/ sems nyid kyi stong pa stong pa nyid la nges shes skyes pa'i phyir ro// de la ji ltar skye zhe na gzugs brnyan dang*/ sgyu ma yul gyis stong pa nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa bzhin du rang gis rang la nges pa'i shes pa 'dren no// de ltar sems kyi stong nyid la nges pa thob pa la mtshan ma med pa zhes bya'o// rang rig rtog pa med pa'i mngon sum nges gyur pa/

bde chen rtog med khyad par skal pa mnyam pa mthong zhes so// nang du sems kyi don skye med mthong ba'i shugs kyis/ phyi'i yul stong par rtogs pa ni rnal 'byor gyis mngon sum yin/ de yang dang po'i shes pa ngos zin pa 'di nyid yin/ shes rab kyi mig gis sems la bltas pas/ sems kyi ngo bo thog ma dang tha ma yod pa ma yin te/ nam mkha' dang 'dra'o// dbus ni ci yang ma yin pa'i phyir phyag rgya chen po ni bdag gis smrar mi nus so// zhes gsungs te/ tha mal gyi shes pa'i ngo bo la bsgom bya'i yul dang*/ sgom byed kyi mkhan po// gnyis 'dzin gyi bsam gtan dang bral bas/ bsgom du med pa bsgom pa'i mchog /ces bya'o// rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i sems kyi stong nyid mngon sum du mthong ba'i don de la chos kyi sku zhes bya ste/ de la tshes gcig gi zla ba zla ba yin kyang gsal ba'i don byed mi nus pas tshes gcig gi zla ba'i dpe dang*/ seng ge'i phru gu seng ge yin yang gzhan zil gyis gnon mi nus pas seng ge'i phru gu'i dpe dang*/ byis pa (8ba)chung ngu mi yin yang mi tshad ldan stobs ldan ma yin pas byis pa chung ngu'i dpe rnams kyi sgo nas sems rtogs par bya/ de yang ma bcos par gzhag pas nyams su myong ste/ myong ba'i don la yang dang yang du nges pa thob par byas pas gsal la 'dzin med 'ong*/ de la yun ring du gnas shing mi 'gyur ba la yon tan du mi blta ste/ gnas par 'dod na 'ching ba'i bsam gtan du 'gro /rang bzhin ngo bo ni sems ma bcos pa kho na yin te/ gsal la 'dzin pa med pa 'di nyams su myong zhing rtogs pa thob pa ni/ skye 'jig dang bral ba dang*/ dus thams cad pa dang*/ rgyun chad med pa dang*/ mi 'gyur ba dang*/ thams cad la khyab pa dang*/ don rnams nyams su myong zhing rtogs pa thob pa ni dam pa mthong ba yin te/ da ni bdag gis su la yang dri bar mi bya'o zhes gsungs so// de yang dang po dmigs pa dang rtsol bas mi sgrub bar du mi gnas/

tha mar yin nam min nam snyam pa'i rtogs pa dang bral bar bya'o// dus rtag tu dran pa rgyun chags kyi ting nge 'dzin dang 'bral bar mi bya/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dang mi 'bral ba'i sgo nas/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba rgyun chad med pas lus sems la bslan pa ste/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan thob par bya/ byams pa dang snying rjes kun nas bslangs pa'i ngo bo byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis dang mi 'bral bar bya'o// zhes gsungs/ thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug pa'i rtogs pa sgrub pa zhes bya ba rje sgam po pa'i chos lags so/// /yang chos rje sgam po pa'i zhal nas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa la/ sdom pa gsum dang ldan dgos gsung*/ sdom pa gsum dang ldan dgos par ga nas bshad snyam na/ rgyud rdo rje rtse mo nas/ byang chub sems 'dzin gyur nas ni/ lha gzhan (9na)la ni mi mos pas// dkon mchog gsum la dad pa dang*// de la gzhol zhing 'bab pa yin// gsod dang rku dang 'khrig pa dang*// rdzun dang chang ni rnam par spang*// khyim pa'i tshul du gnas na ni// gsang sngags rgyal po rab tu sgrub// gal te de ni rab byung na// sdom pa gsum la gnas par bya// so sor thar dang byang chub sems// rig 'dzin nang gi sdom pa'o// gnyis po rig 'dzin rten yin te// yang na rig 'dzin nang du 'dus// zhes gsungs pas na/ de yang so sor thar pa'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa ni/ grogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa thob pa yan chad dang 'brel/ cho ga skyabs su 'gro ba yan chad dang 'brel/ bslab bya rtsa ba bzhi chang dang bcas pa bsrung*/ dge tshul gyi sdom pa ni grogs mkhan po dang*/ slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dang 'brel/ cho ga skyabs su 'gro ba dang 'brel/ bslab bya rtsa ba bzhi dang 'brel/ yan lag drug mkhan po las thob pa bsrung*/ dge slong gi sdom pa ni grogs mkhan po dang slob dpon gnyis/

dge 'dun mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dang 'brel/ cho ga gsol ba dang bzhi'i las la sogs pa dang 'brel/ bslab bya khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum la sogs pa phran tshegs dang bcas pa bsrung bar bya'o// byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa ni/ yul bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dang 'brel/ cho ga smon 'jug don dam byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang 'brel/ bslab bya ni rang gi srog la bab kyang*/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems mi btang zhing*/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug la sogs pa mdor na sdom pa nyi shu pa dang*/ tshul khrims kyi le'u la sogs pa nas gsungs pa bzhin du bslab par bya'o// theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi sdom pa ni/ yul (9ba)rdo rje slob dpon dang 'brel/ cho ga dbang dang byin rlabs kyi rim pa dang 'brel/ bslab bya rtsa ltung yan lag dang bcas pa la bslab par bya'o// de lta bu'i sdom pa gsum gyi ngo bo ni/ rnam snang mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud las/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa'i ngo bo ni gzhan la gnod pa gzhi dang bcas pa las rnam pa thams cad du log pa yin la/ byang chub sems dpa'i ngo bo ni de'i steng du/ sems can la phan 'dogs pa'o zhes gsungs pa dang*/ yang rdo rje gur las/ phung po sangs rgyas lnga bdag nyid// de la brnyas pa brgyad pa yin// zhes pa gsang sngags kyi sdom pa'i ngo bo ni/ rnam pa lhar gsal ba/ nyams myong bde ba/ rang bzhin mi rtog pa gsum dbyer med pa'o// de yang rten gyi gang zag la sdom pa gsum po de gnas na ji ltar gnas/ bsrung na ji ltar bsrung*/ ldan na ji ltar ldan/ phyir bcos na ji ltar 'chos/ mi 'gal bar bsrung na ji ltar bsrung zhe na/ de la sdom gsum gyi ngo bo ni gcig tu gnas pa'ang ma yin te/ dang po skye ba'i rgyu phyogs gcig pa med pa la/ tha dad du bshad pa dang*/ grub pa'i sde mi gcig ste/ dang po thob pa'i dus gcig pa med de/

rim pa bzhin du thob dgos pa dang*/ gnas pa'i dus gcig pa med de/ so sor thar pa'i rtsa ba ni ji srid 'tsho'i bar yin la/ sdom pa gnyis po ni dus snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar yin pa dang*/ gtong ba'i rgyu gcig min te/ so sor thar pa'i rtsa ba bzhi shor na gtong bar bshad la/ byang chub sems dpa'i dbang du byas na mi dge ba bcu la yid kyi gsum po ma gtogs pa bdun po sems can gyi don du 'gyur bar bshad pa dang*/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg par ni de dag nyid lam du gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ yang rten dang ngo bo la'ang tha dad de/ so sor (10na)thar pa ni gling gsum gyi skyes pa dang*/ bud med la skye bar bshad la/ sdom pa gnyis po ni/ skyes pa dang*/ ma ning dang*/ mtshan gnyis dang*/ byang gi sgra mi snyan dang*/ lha dang klu la sogs pa mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad spangs pa thams cad la skye bar bshad pa dang*/ sdom pa rang gi ngo bo 'gal te/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa'i ngo bo ni sems ma yin te/ sems las byung ba yul dang dbang po lnga dang bcu ste/ rnam par rig pa'i gzugs ma yin pa la/ rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs/ bstan du med cing thogs pa med pa'i gzugs su 'dod pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' ni sems kyi khyad par la 'dod pa dang*/ gsang sngags ni lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes la 'dod pas/ ngo bo 'gal bar gnas pa dang*/ yang sdom pa gnyis po phul yang so sor thar pa gnas par bshad pa dang*/ so sor thar pa phul yang gnyis po mi gtong bar bshad pas/ des na sdom pa gcig pa'ang mi btub bo// sdom pa gsum po'i ngo bo gnas skabs thams cad du tha dad du'ang mi btub ste/ tha dad na rang rig mngon sum las 'di ni/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa'o// 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa/ 'di gsang sngags kyi sdom pa yin zhes/ sems tha dad pa gsum du snang bar rigs pa la/ sems gcig las med pa'i phyir/

thams cad du tha dad pa'ang mi 'thad do// 'o na ji ltar gnas zhe na/ sdom pa gsum ngo bo shin tu tha dad gnas skabs 'dres pa'i tshul du gnas pa yin te/ dper na chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa la/ tha dad med kyang ngang pas chu gzhag nas 'o ma blang du btub pa bzhin du sdom pa gsum po 'di yang gang rung zhig phul nas kyang*/ gnyis po gnas su btub (10ba)pas des na ngo bo tha dad/ gnas skabs 'dres pa'i tshul du gnas so// bsrung na ji ltar bsrung zhe na/ bsrung na 'chol bar bsrung ste/ sdom pa gsum po na ba la sogs pa'i srog gi bar chad du 'gro ba dang*/ sdom pa gnyis po'i bar chad du gang 'gro ba dang*/ lam gong ma rgyud la skye ba'i bar chad dang*/ bar chad gsum po dang*/ sdom pa gsum po 'dom thug byung na/ bar chad du gang 'gro ba de ma bsrungs kyang nyes pa med pas/ bsrung na de ltar 'chol bar bsrungs so// ldan na yar ldan te/ theg pa gsum gyis nges 'byung la// theg pa gcig gi 'bras bur gnas// shes gsungs pas/ chung ngu'i ngor chen po mi gtong ste/ so sor thar pa dang byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa nang thug byung na/ byang chub sems dpa' ltar spyad la/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pas so sor thar pa yal bar dor ba la nyes pa med/ byang chub sems dpa' dang gsang sngags 'dom thug byung na/ gsang sngags ltar spyad la/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yal bar dor ba la nyes pa med de/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gong ma bsrungs pas nyes pa med/ 'og ma mi gnas pas nyes pa med/ nyes pa gnyis po gang med pa cho ga btsan po// thabs bzang po// theg pa'i go rim sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa yin gsung*/ de ltar ma yin te/ gong ma dor nas 'og ma bsrung na/ 'og ma bsrungs pas nyes pa bskyed/ gong ma dor bas nyes pa bskyed/ nyes pa gnyis gang bskyed pa de cho ga dman pa thabs dman pa la zhugs pa/ theg pa'i go rim nor ba/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa ma lon pa ste/

chung ngu'i ngor chen po btang ba'i phyir ro// de bas na ldan na yar ldan no// (11na)phyir 'chos na grub mtha' bzhin du phyir 'chos te/ so sor thar pa dang 'gal na bsam pa dang sbyor ba'i sgo nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang 'gal na stobs bzhi'i sgo nas/ gsang sngags kyi sdom pa dang 'gal na bshags sdom/ dbang rigs kyi sgo nas phyir 'chos/ de yang de gsum dang*/ chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa la ni bshags pa la tshegs med de/ de ltar yang*/ bshags bya bshags byed bshags pa rnams// gang tshe rnal 'byor pas ma mthong*// rang bzhin dag pas yongs su mthong*// de ni bshags pa'i sdom pa mchog /ces gsungs so// sdom pa gsum po de ngo bo gcig /gnas skabs tha dad/ gong gi 'gal ba ltar snang ba rnams/ mi 'gal bar bsrung na ji ltar bsrung zhe na/ de la mi 'gal ba rnam pa drug ste/ dus mi 'gal ba ni/ nyin mo so sor thar pa mi 'gal/ mtshan mo gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang mi 'gal/ gnyis kar byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang mi 'gal bar bya'o// gnas mi 'gal ba ni/ grong khyer du so sor thar pa dang mi 'gal/ dgon pa dben par gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang mi 'gal/ gnyis kar byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang mi 'gal bar bya'o// grogs mi 'gal ba ni/ nyan thos kyi nang du so sor thar pa dang mi 'gal/ theg pa chen po'i rigs can gyi nang du byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang mi 'gal/ rgyud smin grol dang ldan pa'i nang du gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang mi 'gal bar bya'o// rkyen mi 'gal ba ni/ na ba dang*/ srog gi bar chad du 'gro ba dang*/ lam gong ma'i bar chad du 'gro na mi bya ste/ ma bsrungs kyang 'gal ba med do// bsam pa mi 'gal (11ba)ba ni/ gzhan don du 'gyur ba dang*/ lam gong ma rang gi rgyud la brten nas/ srog gcod pa la sogs pa byas kyang mi 'gal lo// gang zag gi gnas pas mi 'gal ba ni/

bsad pa gso nus/ rig ma 'gugs nus/ dngos po sped nus pas de ltar byas kyang 'gal ba med do// de ltar bslab pa gsum po rnams kyang*/ 'dom thug byung ba'i dus su shes rab kyis srang la dbab/ gnang bkag gis kyang 'di'i dus na/ 'gal bya che shos spang pa'i don du chung shos gnang*/ che shos spangs pas nyes pa med/ chung shos gnang pas nyes pa med de/ shes rab thabs dang ldan pa yis// dus tshod gtso bor khyer ba gces// zhes gsungs pas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/ rgyud sdom pa gsum dang ldan par bya gsung*/// /yang rje sgam po pa'i zhal nas/ spyir phyag rgya chen po la dbye ba med kyang*/ rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis phyag rgya chen po'i don khong du chud par bya ba'i ched du'am/ ma rtogs pa rtogs par bya ba'i ched tsam du/ dbye ba rnam pa gnyis te/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa dang*/ snang ba lhan cig skyes pa gnyis yin gsung*/ de la sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa ni/ chos kyi sku yin/ snang ba lhan cig skyes pa ni chos sku'i 'od yin/ de yang sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku ste/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba/ kha dog dang dbyibs dang bral ba/ rang bzhin ma bcos pa'o// ngo bo ngos bzung dang bral ba/ dpe nam mkha' lta bu yin te gang du yang khyab pa/ rnam par rtog pa med pa/ mi 'gyur ba ngo bo nyid kyi stong pa nyid kyis stong pa zhig yin/ snang ba lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku'i 'od ni/ rgyu rkyen dang bral bas rang byung rtog pa'i 'od dba' (12na)rlabs dang bral ba/ glo bur gyi dge ba dang mi dge ba dang*/ lung ma bstan pa'i rnam rtog du ma dang bcas pa 'di yin/ de gnyis gcig gam tha dad na ma rtogs pa rnams tha dad pa ltar snang yang bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gis rtogs pa rnams la gcig yin te/ dper na tsandan dang tsandan gyi dri'am/ nyi ma dang nyi ma'i 'od zer ram/

chu dang chu'i rlabs lta bu/ de yang tsandan gyi dris phyogs thams cad du khyab kyang tsandan las ma 'das/ nyi ma'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro yang*/ nyi ma las ma 'das/ chu'i rlabs chu'i rang bzhin las ma 'das pa dang 'dra ste/ snang ba lhan cig skyes pa yang sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa las ma 'das te/ de ltar rtogs par byed pa'i chos gsum ste/ gzhi cir yang ma yin pa las sna tshogs su shar bar shes par bya ba dang*/ sna tshogs su shar yang don ci yang ma yin par shes par bya ba dang*/ rtogs pa'i dus na gnyis med smrar mi btub par shes par bya'o// de la gzhi ci yang ma yin pa ni sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'o// sna tshogs su shar ba ni snang ba lhan cig skyes pa'o// sna tshogs su shar yang don ci yang ma yin pa ni/ rnam par rtog pa du ma ste don ci yang ma yin par mi bden par shes par bya'o// rtogs pa'i dus su gnyis med smrar mi btub par bya ba ni/ snang ba dang rtogs pa gnyis med du rtogs pa don smrar med pa/ lkugs pa'am bu chung gis rmi lam rmis pa lta bur go ba'i lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rtogs par byed pa la/ nyams su len dgos pas nyams su blang ba'i chos gsum ste/ dang po 'bad rtsol dang bral ba'i sgo nas lus sems glod pa dang*/ bar du the tshom dang bral ba'i sgo nas ma bcos pa'i ngang la bzhag pa dang*/ tha ma byung tshor gyi (12ba)rnam par rtog pa thams cad skye med du shes par bya'o// de yang sbyor ba'i dus su 'bad rtsol dang bral ba'i sgo nas/ lus sems khong glod pa/ dngos gzhi'i dus su the tshom dang bral ba'i sgo nas/ dus gsum gyi rnam par rtog pa dang bral bar byas la gnas lugs ma bcos pa'i ngang la bzhag /rjes kyi shes pa la rnam par rtog pa ci skyes thams cad sngar 'dris kyi mi dang phrad pa ltar shes par byas la byung tshor gyi rnam par rtog pa thams cad skye med du shes par bya'o// de la rgyas 'debs dgos pas mtha' rten gyi gdams ngag gsum ste/

'gro ba thams cad kyi rgyud la yod pa'i lhan cig skyes pa yin pas rang la yod pas gzhan nas btsal mi dgos/ sdug bsngal spangs pa'i bde ba chen po chos kyi sku rang gi rig pa kho na yin pas logs na med/ snang grags kyi chos thams cad rang gi sems yin pas rang sems la rang 'jigs mi dgos pas nyam nga ba dang bag tsha ba thong*/ de yang 'gro ba thams cad kyi rgyud la yod pa ni rigs drug gi sems can yin phan chad/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyis ma khyab pa mi srid pas na gzhan nas btsal mi dgos/ sdug bsngal spangs pa ni 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad chos nyid kyi ngang la sangs kyis dag pas/ bde chen chos kyi sku rang gi rig pa yin pas sems nyid las ma gtogs pa logs na med/ snang grags kyi chos thams cad rang gi sems yin pas thams cad sems su shes/ rang sems 'od gsal du shes/ 'od gsal gyi rang bzhin chos nyid du shes/ chos nyid sems kyi ngang du gnas nas/ sems can thams cad lha'i bu'i bdud du song yang*/ gnod pa skyel sa ma rnyed/ gnod pa skyel mkhan gyi bdud de rang chos nyid yin pas/ chos nyid kyis chos nyid la glags mi rnyed/ de'i phyir nyam nga ba dang (13na)bag tsha ba thams cad chos nyid kyi ngang du thong gsung*/ chos rje sgam po pa'i gsung la/ nye gnas sho sgom byang chub ye shes kyis zin bris su mdzad pa/ bdag gis phyogs cig tu bsgrigs pa'o/// /chos thun dgu yod// dge'o// bkra shis so/// /
